If the chosen path doesn't suit you, you can go back and try a different path without having to start over from the beginning.

Features of the game

11 different endings About 26 thousand words More than 1500 images Ability to return to a previous choice

Installation:
1. Unpack the archive (make sure the folder path has Latin characters only).
2. Run the game.
